audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 of the chart contradicted their own prose: win[1] said Skill while whys[1] says mini-Gnar kites you for free at 2, and win[2] said Ornn while whys[2] says the lane 'evens out into a skill fight'.
audit.why: Mirror (gnar__ornn) flipped exactly these two rows as one group (level 2 rated 7/10 to Gnar, level 3 rated 5/10 Skill), and the packet chart agrees: Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Ornn, Gnar, Ornn, Ornn.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side to Gnar at 3/10, win[2]/phases[2].side to Skill at 5/10, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Everything keyed off 'GNAR!'s cooldown' as if the transform were a cooldown you could count — including at level 2, where he has no ultimate at all.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30s but Rage governs the transform, so tracking the number tells you nothing. Hop is the cooldown that actually gates his lane: 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s.
audit.corrected: Hop's 22s and the Rage caveat written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[1].why and winCon.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Volcanic Rupture grounds Hop, which is mini-Gnar's entire escape from your melee range.
audit.why: Ornn Q carries the grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes'); Gnar E carries the dash flag. Grounding him is what converts your E-into-pillar knockup from a telegraph into a hit.
audit.corrected: Written into tldr, winCon, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[1].text.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Gnar's GNAR! is down.
edits.after: Mini Gnar kites you with Boomerang Throw and Hop — no shield yet, so soak the poke and last-hit.

edits.before: His %HP hurts — W-brittle mini, respect Mega CC. Ornn wins the GNAR! cooldown windows.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture grounds Hop — wall his kite, then W-brittle mini before Rage fills.

edits.before: Brittle mini and dodge Mega. Track GNAR! before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Ground his Hop with Volcanic Rupture (9s), then E into that pillar and Brittle him in mini form.

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. Dodge/E-knock it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gnar Hop: 22s at rank 1, 12s maxed — Volcanic Rupture grounds it, so he cannot leave. - GNAR!: 90s at rank 1 but only 30s maxed, and Rage decides the timing, not the cooldown. - Call of the Forge God: 140s.

edits.before: His Mega all-in. Dodge/E-knock it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rage, not a cooldown, decides it. Fight him mini and ground the Hop.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun): His Mega all-in. Dodge/E-knock it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture grounds Hop (22s at rank 1) — the kite ends and your E into the pillar lands.

edits.before: Second point in your E-into-Q-pillar lets you punish a Gnar who steps up to last-hit in melee range with a knock-up.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture grounds Hop, so a Gnar who steps up to last-hit cannot leave — E into the pillar for the knock-up.

notes: Not asserted, flagged instead: GNAR! stuns any enemy thrown into a wall, and Volcanic Rupture plants a magma pillar next to you. If the pillar counts as a wall for that check, Ornn hands Mega Gnar a free stun with his own Q — a genuinely matchup-deciding quirk. Riot's text does not settle whether player-created terrain qualifies, so nothing was written. The mirror audit appears to have stopped at the same point. dosFull[2].t 'W-brittle mini-Gnar' is 19 characters, under the applier's 25-character floor, so it cannot be corrected through a proposal.
